		How to evaluate on this task
	

You can evaluate an embedding model on this dataset using the following code:
import mteb

task = mteb.get_tasks(["STS12"])
evaluator = mteb.MTEB(task)

model = mteb.get_model(YOUR_MODEL)
evaluator.run(model)
